result.rationale: Midway/CHIL1 is a facility, not an operating company. CIM closed its four-asset sale to a Harrison Street-1547 JV on 2021-11-02 and identified 1547 as its prior JV partner; 1547 manages the assets. Count once at the joint portfolio/platform level. Merge task 280 into corrected task 273, without implying Harrison Street owns 1547. Stakes, JV name and Harrison Street fund are undisclosed.
